*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

**Mirrorsoul Attunement (Su):** The mirrorsoul weaver can invest essence in their mirrorsoul, a unique attunement augmenting their species bond abilities. Whenever one of creatures that is part of the mirrorkin’s source-group bond casts a spell, manifests a power, or uses a spell-like ability of 1st level the mirrorsoul may use an immediate action to imprint that effect with this attunement. For the following round the mirrorsoul weaver can activate the imprinted effect as a spell-like ability (all effects are based off of their own Intelligence modifier). They can activate a spell-like ability from an imprint once per day per point of Intelligence modifier. For each essence invested in this ability the mirrorsoul weaver my imprint a spell, power, or effect of up to one level higher and the imprint lasts 1 round longer.

This ability replaces mystic attunement.

**Hostile Attunement Bond (Su):** At 5th level, the mirrorsoul weaver gains the ability to make a second imprint while imprinting another effect. In addition they can use an immediate action to both bond and imprint an enemy spellcaster. Calculate changes to the mirrorkin as normal for their source-group bond ability, and then imprint the cast spell, power or effect as normal. This bond cannot be severed by the target as a normal bond and instead natural collapses normally caster after the imprint wears off.

**Expanded Attunement (Su):** At 9th level, the mirrorsoul gains the ability to make a third imprint make and maintain an additional bond. Ally bonds may now be imprinted and maintained for duration of the sourcegroup bond but may not be activated more times that the mirrorsoul weaver’s Intelligence modifier. Hostile imprints now last 1 minute per invested essence.

**Deeper Attunement (Su):** At 13th level, the mirrorsoul weaver may make a fourth imprint. Hostile imprints now last 10 minutes per point of invested essence.

Additionally, the mirrorsoul weaver may now activate hostile imprints an additional number of times equal to their Charisma modifier.
